## Use case

Describe the task you want to complete and the current limitation.

## Proposed behavior

Explain the desired behavior. For a new integration, include the application's official documentation, operating system, and configuration method if known.

## Alternatives

Describe any existing workaround or alternative you considered.

Do not include credentials, private application profiles, or account information.
